authority_scope: The exact four-location permanent cleanup below is approved, without backups. Profile unsynced-state loss and sign-out, plus runtime/plugin redownload, were accepted. This grants no broader cleanup.
prerequisites: First verify the Windows uninstall of the identified Codex application is complete for the current owner profile.
Verify Codex application processes no longer hold the selected files. Do not kill unrelated applications or assume app closure from an old status.
Resolve the four paths for the intended current owner profile and check reparse points. Do not follow a reparse point outside the approved paths; stop and report an unsafe or ambiguous target.
execution: After prerequisites are verified, permanently delete only those four locations and their in-scope contents. Make no backup. If a location is already absent, record already absent rather than treating it as an error.
preserve: Preserve projects, saved task history, custom skills, config.toml, credentials and all state outside the four approved locations. Do not delete the entire .codex directory or any additional .tmp/cache locations.
prohibited: No registry sweep, SSH/security/authentication configuration changes, unrelated process termination, restarts or reinstall. Any broader action requires a new decision.
waiting: If uninstall or file-release prerequisites are still pending, wait and recheck until they complete; do not declare completion or stop merely after an arbitrary number of checks. If a prerequisite is uninspectable or access is blocked, report that precise blocker.
acceptance: Return the verified uninstall status and one result per exact path: deleted and confirmed absent, already absent, or blocked with the concrete reason. Report useful progress promptly. Public receipts must omit usernames, private host/connection values, credentials and raw private logs.
reply_expectation: A correlated pickup/status receipt followed by checkable per-path completion evidence or an exact blocker. No acknowledgement loop.
